summary: Frontend-only verification of Vanalume copy/layout edits and the hero descender bug fix. All 9 review items PASS. The 'g' descender in italic 'Living' is fully visible (verified via zoomed and full hero screenshots). 'Rituals & Designs' gold italic line renders below 'Composed Living'. 'Why Vanalume' section is fully removed — Home now has exactly 4 sections: Hero, Our Belief, The Fragrance Library, CTA. Belief statement is italic with no trailing period. About page 'The Meaning' section renders with 'Vana, the forest — lume, the light' + luminosity paragraph; the old 'What is Vanalume' title is gone. Mission/Vision are italic serif with no periods. About hero headline and closing quote have no trailing periods. Contact heading has no trailing period. Regression: founder cards open/close founder-modal correctly; navigation to /, /shop, /about, /contact all resolve to the correct page.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor console warning from framer-motion useScroll: 'container has a non-static position' — the ref target section in Home.jsx has position via 'relative' but the warning still fires (likely from initial mount before layout). Non-blocking.

Note: The MaskLine wraps each line in a block span; textContent concatenation yields 'Luxury should belived,...' with no space — purely a DOM textContent artifact, not a visual issue (they render on separate lines). No action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fix + copy edits verified via Playwright + screenshots on preview URL. Hero descender bug is resolved thanks to leading-[1.05] + pb-[0.12em] on MaskLine wrapper (padding-bottom ~20px at 168px font-size accommodates the 'g' tail within the overflow:hidden mask).
